facebook.caption:
4.9 stars. 208 reviews. Family restaurant in Ong Lang that almost nobody talks about.

Gold Garden Restaurant sits away from the main tourist drag, which is exactly why the locals keep going back. $15-30 per person gets you a full meal, not a side dish. Ong Lang itself is quieter, slower, the Phu Quoc that existed before the resorts arrived.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
